ev_0005.summary: Figure: circle centered at O (303.5,184.1), radius 118. Base segment AB is horizontal at y=361 (A at x=67.6, B at x=540.2). Apexes C (303.5,66) connect to A and B by segments AC and BC. Vertical segment CD runs at x=304 from C through O and H (304,208) down to D (304,361). C lies on the circle, and the vertical chord from C to the unlabeled circle-bottom point S (304,302.1) is a diameter through O. The horizontal chord y=208 (x 182 to 426) passes through H and crosses the circle at unlabeled points P (188.7,208.6) and Q (418.3,208.6). No right angles are claimed (the marker tool did not verify D or H).
